propositions: Replace fuzzy ordinal severity labels (low/medium/high) on undecomposed and dod_uncertifiable axes with deterministic closed kind sets that map to either advisory (0.55) or flooring (0.85) outcomes.
Rewrite both verifier prompts to enumerate six distinct defect kinds per axis with pick-rules, removing the inert G5-suppressor hedge and dead ordinal-parsing code.

Convert impact_plan() to read the new kind-set axes through _PLAN_GRADED_AXES instead of _SEV01, ensuring all three consumption sites (MAX contrib, has_override floor loop, dod amplifier) apply consistent semantics.
Bump IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION from plan-v4 to plan-v5 as a single cohesive change encompassing both axis conversions, hedge removal, and margin telemetry per ADR 0054 Section 4.
Implement zero-LLM re-score validation over 22,667 recorded findings against a pinned plan-v4 baseline to detect unjustified lost blocks, with all results audited and landed under docs/calibration/.
